summary: LibrePhotos is a self-hosted photo management service designed as an alternative to proprietary cloud solutions like Google Photos. It allows you to organise and browse your image library through a web interface, featuring visual analytics and graphs. The project is built using Python and distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It is well-suited for privacy-conscious users who want to host their own image archive and explore visual breakdowns of their collection.
watchOut: Self-hosted photo management can be resource-intensive when indexing large libraries, and feature completeness may lag behind commercial alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your image storage and database, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
